changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/default-children-retired-5051.md`

- names `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` → `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` — edited by this change

  > **If you author plugins against the published register-meta table, drop the key.** It is gone from `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md`, which had been teaching it. A meta that still declares it stays *valid*: `ComponentMetaSchema` is a plain `z.object`, and measured on zod 4.4.3 that STRIPS unknown keys rather than rejecting them — so the key is silently dropped from the parse output instead of failing validation. TypeScript authors get the loud signal instead: all three `ComponentMeta` declarations (`@object-ui/types` `base.ts` and `plugin-scope.ts`, `@object-ui/core` `Registry.ts`) no longer offer it, so re-declaring it is now a compile error.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `88a4ef616` (merge-base with origin/main): 1 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1283 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1851 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36015218362)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `05161c6089c41bcb61e4c36fc5e205ec1321eaa8`

Rendered by an isolated review subagent spawned by the `domain:ui#4` seat; its served tier was checked against its transcript stamps (86 of 86 at the review tier). Adopted by this seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Diff scope is exactly the two ruled lines.** GitHub `pulls/10268/files`: 1 file, +2/-2; local three-dot diff against the true merge-base `142fdfd8` (`mergeable_state: behind`) is the same one file; `main` has not touched `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` since that merge-base (empty diff `142fdfd8..88a4ef61` on the path). No control bytes or trailing whitespace on the added lines. RIGHT.
- **"Layout container" is the ruled meaning and matches every other published face on the companion branch.** Ruling 5814512168 Q2: "`isContainer` means layout container … no longer 'can have children'". Companion PR #10267 head `f34809934bcb86c9708f2a57da98d8ce580a8239`: `packages/types/src/base.ts:1078-1089` ("LAYOUT containment … Not 'can have children' … declared in `inputs` as `{ name: 'children', type: 'slot' }`"), `packages/types/src/widget.ts:116-122`, `packages/types/src/zod/base.zod.ts:730`, `packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts:72-79`, `packages/sdui-parser/src/types.ts:160`, `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md:146-153`, `content/docs/guide/component-registry.md:138-143`. The guide's row says the same thing in the same vocabulary. RIGHT.
- **"skipped by the react-page JSX scope" is precisely what the flag does.** `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/react-page.tsx:69-98` `buildComponentScope` iterates `ComponentRegistry.getPublicConfigs()` (the `tier: 'public'` set, `packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts:969`) and does `if (!tag || cfg.isContainer) continue;` at line 77 — identical on `main` and on the companion head, untouched by #10267 (its body's A4, verified by diff). Pinned by `packages/components/src/__tests__/react-page-scope.test.tsx:95-98` and `apps/console/src/__tests__/public-contract.test.ts:533`. Precision note, not a defect: the loop only ever sees public-tier configs, so for an internal (default-tier) plugin block the flag has no react-page effect either way — the sentence does not claim otherwise, and the `tier` row sits three lines below it. RIGHT.
- **Every other reader of `isContainer` on the companion branch is a layout-containment or carry-through reader, none a containment-diagnostic reader.** `git grep` over `f3480993` non-test source: `react-page.tsx:75,77` (scope skip); `page.tsx:481`, `sdui-parser/src/index.ts:198`, `core/src/registry/WidgetRegistry.ts:190` (manifest/meta projection); `sdui-parser/src/codegen.ts:176` (`generateBlockList` "container" column — now literally layout container, noted in #10267's acceptance notes); `apps/console/src/__tests__/public-contract.test.ts:490` (`DECLARED_LAYOUT_CONTAINERS` = LayoutSchema union arms with `isContainer === true` — this is the "public layout ledger" the ruling names); `PageBlockCanvas.tsx:710` is an unrelated local variable. `validate.ts` and `body-dialect.ts` mention the flag only in comments saying it is NOT read. RIGHT.
- **"the SDUI parser's `not-a-container` reads that input" is true on the companion branch and only that input.** `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts:33` `CHILD_LIST_KEY = 'children'`; `:57-59` `acceptsChildren(comp)` returns whether `comp.inputs` has some input whose `name === CHILD_LIST_KEY`; `:220-223` `if (node.children?.length && !acceptsChildren(comp))` pushes `code: 'not-a-container'`; `:150` the retired-`body` site is handed the same predicate; `:48-55` and `:217-219` state no `isContainer` fallback. Pinned by `packages/sdui-parser/src/__tests__/containment-declared-slot-9910.test.ts:70-90` (flag-only draws the warning; slot-only draws nothing; array-typed `children` also counts). RIGHT.
- **The `{ name: 'children', type: 'slot' }` spelling is the one the parser and the types accept.** `'slot'` is an arm of `ComponentInputControlType` (`packages/types/src/base.ts:636-647`), of `ComponentInputControlTypeSchema` (`packages/types/src/zod/base.zod.ts:564-576`), of `MANIFEST_INPUT_TYPES` (`packages/sdui-parser/src/input-type.ts:16-28`) and of `ManifestInputType` (`packages/sdui-parser/src/types.ts:62`). A slot arm is never type-checked (`validate.ts:252-280` `armAccepts` default true) and `children` is a `BASE_PROPS` key (`validate.ts:76-85`), so declaring it can never draw `unknown-prop`/`type-mismatch` (pinned at `containment-declared-slot-9910.test.ts:93-99`). It is also the literal spelling of the ruling's Q1 and of the 67 companion registrations (e.g. `flex.tsx`, `sidebar.tsx`). The predicate is name-based, so the guide's spelling is the canonical one rather than the only one — correct for a guide. RIGHT.
- **Nothing else in the file is made false by Q1/Q2.** Full grep of the 481-line head file for `isContainer|container|children|slot|child|nest|wrap|compose|layout`: line 98 lists `'slot'` among the eleven control kinds (still eleven on the companion branch); line 241 says `children` is INHERITED from `BaseSchema` (still true — `children` is the protocol's base key, `validate.ts:29-31`); line 315's "slot" is the widget `error` prop, unrelated. The sample `MyWidget` (lines 189-228) spreads `schema` into the impl but renders no `children`, so `isContainer: false` with no `children` input is exactly the Q1/Q2-consistent shape for that example. The pending changeset `.changeset/default-children-retired-5051.md` that names this guide is about the retired `defaultChildren` key and is unaffected. RIGHT.
- **Truth on `main` today — sequencing risk, not a defect.** On `88a4ef61` `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts:173` still reads `if (node.children?.length && !comp.isContainer)` (and `:105` hands `comp.isContainer` to the body-dialect check), and 65 children-rendering registrations carry no `children` input. If #10268 lands before #10267, the row's second sentence describes a parser that does not exist yet and an author who follows it (flag false, slot declared) draws a FALSE `not-a-container` on `main` until #10267 merges. Cross-repo: objectstack's save-gate copy `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts:168` at `2c1011b` still reads `!comp.isContainer` until objectstack#19969 lands (ruling Q3: same release, same pin bump). Recommendation to the seat: land #10267 first, or in the same release, as the PR body already proposes. SEQUENCING RISK, reported.
- **Wording clarity for an AI plugin author.** The table row is complete and self-contained: it names the flag's one behaviour, the negative ("Not 'accepts children'"), the exact declaration to write, and the diagnostic that reads it. Two nits, neither false: (a) the inline comment "Layout region? (react-page scope)" is terse and "react-page" is defined nowhere else in the published skill (`git grep` over `skills/**` at head: only these two lines) — an author unfamiliar with `kind: 'react'` pages must infer it from the table row directly below; (b) the guide omits the ruling's second layout reader, "the public layout ledger" — harmless for a plugin author (a plugin block is never a `LayoutSchema` arm) and it sidesteps a discrepancy that belongs to #10267, not here: the ruling text says "excluded from … the public layout ledger" while the companion faces (`base.ts:1080`, `base.zod.ts:730`, `flex.tsx:187`) say "listed in". Flagged for the seat to reconcile on #10267's faces; out of this PR's scope. RIGHT, with nits.

### ② Semver level

No changeset is required, and the PR carries none — consistent. Evidence: `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` header (lines 1-160) guards, for every package in `.changeset/config.json` `fixed`, only that package's **published, executable** source — `isPublishedSource` at line 751: `src/**`, the `index.html` entry, or a `package.json` `files` entry, **minus documentation** (`*.md`, `LICENSE*`). `skills/` is not a workspace package (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`: `packages/*`, `examples/*`, `apps/*`, `docs`; no `skills/objectui/package.json`), so no clause reaches it, and the file is `.md` besides. CI `Changeset Declaration` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` are green on the head; the `changeset-claim-re-read` bot comment exits 0 and only asks for a re-read of `default-children-retired-5051.md`, whose sentence about this guide stays true. The ruling's `Clause-②: yes` (published type + diagnostic change) is discharged by #10267's `.changeset/9910-children-slot-declare-and-pin.md`; this docs-only half owes nothing under the repo's rule.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `Part of #9910` present once in the body; a regex scan for `close/closes/closed/fix/fixes/fixed/resolve/resolves/resolved` near any issue number returns zero hits in title and body. No closing keyword aimed at the card. OK.
- Net `skills/**` line count: +2/-2 on one file = net 0; `plugin-development.md` 481 → 481; all `skills/**` markdown 4763 → 4763 (recomputed from `git ls-tree` at `main` and head). Dispatch budget +3 net, unused. OK.
- Commits (`pulls/10268/commits`): exactly one, `05161c6089c41bcb61e4c36fc5e205ec1321eaa8`, author/committer "Claude". Trailers are the ruled model-free pair — `Co-Authored-By` naming Claude at the noreply anthropic address, and `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C` (objectstack `AGENTS.md:451-452`; os-dev.md:284). No `Fable`/`Opus`/`Sonnet`/`claude-*` token anywhere in the message. The subject cites `objectui#9910 Q2` in prose, not as a card trailer or closing keyword. OK.
- Check-runs on the head (re-polled after the first read showed 6 in progress): 39 total — 36 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)`, `dependabot`), 0 failure, 0 pending. Skill gates `Skill Guide Path Check`, `Skill Eval Token Check`, `Skill Example Check` all success (the last was PRECONDITION NOT MET locally and is measured here). Commit status: Vercel success ("Canceled by Ignored Build Step"). OK.
- `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is **green (success)** on this head, and that is the expected reading, not an anomaly: per `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` header and `AGENTS.md:535`, the `pull_request` leg is an early warning that deliberately exits 0 ("绿不等于不受管"); only the `merge_group` leg refuses, and it requires a latest-decisive APPROVED review by `os-zhuang` or `hotlong` (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, line 320). `skills/**` is the `skills-catalog` governed surface (`AGENTS.md:509-521`; PR body reports `--test` → GOVERNED, exit 3). Current state: `draft: true`, 0 reviews, no labels, no requested reviewers — no authorized approval exists yet, so the PR must stay draft; landing is the claiming seat's act after approval (`AGENTS.md:326` ①+②). OK.
- PR body carries the governed-PR `## 维护者速读(草稿)` block with the five fixed sections and the seat opinion left blank (os-dev.md:287-288). OK.
- Companion PR #10267 (`f3480993`, 42 files) touches zero `skills/**` paths (verified by `git diff --name-only`), so the governed half is cleanly separated as the ruling requires. OK.
- `mergeable_state: behind` — the branch predates #10267's merge-base; no conflict on the one touched path. Informational.

## 维护者速读

`domain:ui` 座位 #4(`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`)定稿,对照本 PR 的 diff 校正过草稿。

### 改了什么

本 PR 只改发布给插件作者(包括 AI 作者)的技能说明 `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` 里关于 `isContainer` 的两处描述,原地替换,净增 0 行。
- 旧说法:`isContainer` 表示「能放子组件」。
- 新说法:`isContainer` 表示「布局容器」。
- 真正「能放子组件」要在注册的 `inputs` 里声明 `{ name: 'children', type: 'slot' }`。页面校验器的「不是容器」提示读的就是这个声明。

### 为什么改

这是 objectui#9910 裁决(`5814512168`,批 #220 同意)的第二问。
- 旧说法会把作者带偏:给一个想放子组件的插件打上 `isContainer: true`,这个组件反而会从 react 页面的可用组件里被拿掉。
- 说明书写错一句,等于一个产品缺陷。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

- 纯文字改动,不改任何代码或行为。回滚 = revert 这一个提交。
- ⚠️ **顺序风险**:新说法描述的是代码 PR(同卡的另一半)合入之后的行为。如果本 PR 先合,在代码 PR 落地之前,照新说法写的插件会被校验器误报「不是容器」。⇒ 座位会等代码 PR 合入之后才落地本 PR。你先批准不会有问题。
- 复核:契约复审档独立复核 PASS(`5816657541`,86/86 在档)。CI 36 项成功、3 项按设计跳过、0 红。

### 席位意见

建议批准。措辞与裁决一致,与代码 PR 在各发布面上的描述也一致;复核只提了两处措辞上的小建议(非阻塞)。

### 你要做的

在本 PR 上留一条 APPROVED review(`os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong`)。之后翻 ready、入队都由座位来做,并且会排在代码 PR 合入之后。
